evidence.explanation: JS create_room injected RNG defaults preserve the C zero/one-based draws in tested first-room placement paths.
evidence.proof: Ten public des.room comparisons: fully random, random position, random dimensions, random alignment and fixed control × two seeds. Exact C create_room/check_room/get_rect bodies match acceptance, returned room bounds and primitive RNG consumption. C captures room creation and checks a one-rectangle allocator handoff; no complete storage/topology/allocator mutation proof. Raw JS draw labels retained; rnd is normalized to rn2+1 and C rn1 to rn2+base.
evidence.control: Fixed geometry uses no draws. Invalid one-dimension-random setup was discarded because both production wrappers require paired dimensions; it is not a negative case.
